audience: Founders and operators at growing consumer packaged goods brands managing retail, wholesale, ecommerce, distributors, or third-party logistics.
starting_point: Start with a short intake. Jonathan reviews your bookkeeping and finance needs and emails next steps. If there is a fit, the next step is a free 30-minute conversation. No call is booked automatically.
audit_focus: Review the state of your books, reporting needs, cash questions, and existing systems. Agree what needs cleanup and what ongoing support should cover.
implementation: Bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end reporting, and scoped finance operations and decision support. Scope, timing, responsibilities, and fees are agreed before work begins.
boundaries: No forced ERP replacement. Human review and approval remain part of the work. Tax filing, assurance audits, legal advice, and payment execution are not included. Advisory does not guarantee media coverage or investment.
